child.label: Drive & Self-Discipline
child.description: Questions about getting started on tasks, following through, working hard, procrastinating, and planning to get things done.
child.not_for: Tidiness, attention to detail, caution, and acting or spending on impulse (use Order & Caution).
examples: Do you put off unpleasant tasks?
Do you follow through on your commitments?

child.label: Order & Caution
child.description: Questions about keeping things tidy and orderly, paying attention to detail, taking precautions, and thinking before acting or spending versus acting on impulse.
child.not_for: Getting started, working hard, following through, and procrastination (use Drive & Self-Discipline).
examples: Do you keep your belongings tidy?
Do you often buy things on impulse?
